description: Output of RPC /bee.v1.AgentService/StreamAgentRunEvents: `data` is a bee.v1.AgentRunEvent in proto3-JSON. `bee agent stream-agent-run-events --json` prints one such document per streamed message, one per line (NDJSON); a failure ends the stream with an error document. Errors print a document matching schemas/v1/error.schema.json.
title: bee agent stream-agent-run-events
